pull.title: scripted-diff: [wallet] Remove trailing newlines from one-line log messages
pull.body:
This is a low-prio style cleanup for years, but:

* It is tedious and possibly distracting to do it manually when touching the line for other reasons.
* The topic recently came up again when discussing log injection (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35833#issuecomment-5113804332)

So I wonder if a simple scripted-diff can cover the bulk of the changes now, with hopefully little conflicts with reviewed pull requests.

(Removing the trailing newlines from the remaining log messages is trivial and can be done in a later pull)

39 conflicts right now. Not sure what number is acceptable, but the focus should probably be to not invalidate any current acks

> 39 conflicts right now. Not sure what number is acceptable, but the focus should probably be to not invalidate any current acks.

I've wondered this before, but am again wondering if there's a way to have this drahtbot comment also display how many current (full) ACKs are on each of these? IIRC previously I thought it may be a bit tricky/probably not worth it, but with LLMs maybe it might be possible to show?

I think 39 conflicts is probably a strong enough signal on it's own here, but when there's 5 or 6 it can be useful (but tedious) to click each one and actually see the state of it...

Concept ACK - could a linter check that we don't add new ones?

If we do these big messy refactors, they should be done at the beginning of the release cycle (i.e. soon), and maybe we could ping the people affected, and whoever reviews this could help re-ACK the invalidated ones.
+1 for adding valid ACK count to drahtbot.

> Concept ACK - could a linter check that we don't add new ones?

It should be checked at compile time, but this can be done later.

> If we do these big messy refactors, they should be done at the beginning of the release cycle (i.e. soon)

I'd say no, because the beginning of the cycle is best used for features (gives them more time to sit). Also, backports are easier if refactors are done later.

scripted-diff: [wallet] Remove trailing newlines from one-line log messages

The replacement skips log messages that contain: " or \
This keeps the script simple and allows to handle the special cases
manually.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-

 sed --in-place --regexp-extended 's/(WalletLogPrintf\([^\"]*"[^\"\\]*)\\n"([,)])/\1"\2/g' $(
       git grep -l --extended-regexp 'WalletLogPrintf' ./src
 )

-END VERIFY SCRIPT-
